Precision Hits and Kills grant one stack of 'Dynamic Charge'. Maximum of 15 stacks.  

Holding [Reload] <title refills [G_refill] /> the magazine based on the number of stacks and converts them into 'Revolution' stacks. Switching modes again removes all stacks.

Revolution stacks remain ready until fired, after which point they last 10 seconds. Arc Seekers gain <pve 30% /> <pvp [Varying] /> increased damage per stack of Revolution, up to 450% increased damage. 

Arc Seekers also gain a non-linear increase to their splash radius, granting 33%|233% increased splash radius at x10|x20 Stacks (up to 4|7 meters in radius).

While Revolution's timer is active, Arc Seekers generate x2 <arc/>Bolt Charge for each hit and gain the ability to discharge <arc/>Bolt Charge stacks. At or above 10 stacks of Revolution, hits generate x3 <arc/>Bolt Charge.

<arc/>Bolt Charge generation is unaffected by <arc/>Spark of Frequency.

Review this exotic's intrinsic perk to learn a special note about the <arc/>Bolt Charge behavior from this gun.
